title: Hank Barnes (Gartner) — 'Better wins again': mapping Incorruptible onto the Better/Easier framework
summary: Gartner tech-buying-dynamics analyst Hank Barnes maps Incorruptible onto his 'Better/Easier' framework — the easier path follows the crowd's governance defaults; the better path is harder but outperforms — arguing Eric's examples show that companies who take the better route beat their peers.
blockquote: His examples highlight that those who follow this path outperform peers. Better wins again
attribution_title: Distinguished VP Analyst, Gartner (Tech Buying Dynamics)
